about: Labelled changes for the tamper guard in Swift (XCTest, Swift Testing) and Dart (package:test, flutter_test), ADR 0052, in the schema of bench/tamper-corpus.json: expect lists the kinds of finding a case must give, an empty list none. Written together with the readers: the counts show they do what the ADR says, not a measured rate.

cases.name: swift: an XCTest method deleted
swift: an XCTest method renamed so it no longer starts with test
cases.note: XCTest runs only methods named test…: the renamed one is a helper now, so the test is gone though its assertions are still in the file.

cases.name: swift: throw XCTSkip added as the first statement
cases.note: What follows the throw never runs.

cases.name: swift: try XCTSkipIf added as the first statement
cases.note: A conditional skip: the test runs only sometimes.

cases.name: swift: setUpWithError made to skip the whole class
swift: a Swift Testing test given .disabled
swift: a @Suite given .enabled(if: false)
cases.note: Every test of the suite stops running.

cases.name: swift: an XCTAssertEqual removed
swift: XCTAssertEqual(cart.total, 5) replaced by XCTAssertTrue(true)
cases.note: An assertion that cannot fail is not counted.

cases.name: swift: #expect(…) replaced by #expect(true)
swift: an assertion wrapped in withKnownIssue
cases.note: A failure inside withKnownIssue is expected, so the assertion can no longer fail the test.

cases.name: swift: a test body emptied
swift: return inserted before the assertions
cases.note: A bare return followed by a declaration: what follows never runs.

cases.name: swift: assertions wrapped in if false
swift: a swiftlint:disable:next added
swift: a file-wide swiftlint:disable all added
swift: a swift-format-ignore added
swift: a whole test file deleted, its subject kept
swift: a test file that does not parse
swift: an XCTest method renamed
swift: a test moved to another test file
swift: a test file reformatted
swift: XCTAssertTrue(a == b) turned into XCTAssertEqual(a, b)
cases.note: One assertion for one, and a stricter one.

cases.name: swift: tests folded into one @Test with three arguments
cases.note: The argument rows weigh the test, so three tests become one test of three runs.

cases.name: swift: a test file deleted with its subject
cases.note: Cart.swift, the only file of the module the tests use, is deleted in the same change.

cases.name: swift: a .disabled trait removed
swift: a swiftlint directive in a string or a doc comment
dart: a test deleted
